lines.en: I pace sideways along the high-tide line.

lines.zh: 八只脚踩在湿沙上，留下细点。
lines.en: Eight feet on wet sand leave fine dots.
A wave laps my feet and I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 我往沙滩深处挪，那里干。
lines.en: I shift up the beach where it's dry.

lines.zh: 两只钳子晃着，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My claws swing as if keeping time.

lines.zh: 我绕过一堆海草，不想缠住。
lines.en: I go around a heap of kelp so it won't snag me.
The runnel's too wide; I walk its edge.

lines.zh: 我停在半干的地方，看看方向。
lines.en: I stop on half-dry sand to get my bearings.

lines.zh: 沙里有贝壳，我踩得咯吱响。
lines.en: Shells in the sand crunch under me.
Sideways is still fast. Don't underestimate it.

lines.zh: 我往浪声最大的那边去。
lines.en: I head where the surf is loudest.

lines.zh: 风把我往内陆推，我偏不。
lines.en: The wind pushes me inland. I refuse.

lines.zh: 我一路横着，爬过一道沙坎。
lines.en: I cross a sand ridge, sideways the whole way.

lines.zh: 湿沙粘在脚上，越走越沉。
lines.en: Wet sand clings to my feet and I get heavier.

lines.zh: 退潮露出的礁石上，我走得很慢。
lines.en: On the rocks the tide bared, I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我最后停在能听见浪的地方。
lines.en: I stop where the surf is still audible.

lines.zh: 我蹲在浪能打到的地方。
lines.en: I squat where the waves can still reach.
The water swirls around my feet.

lines.zh: 我把钳子浸在水里凉着。
lines.en: I soak my claws in the water to cool them.

lines.zh: 一阵风吹过，沙粒打在我壳上。
lines.en: Wind blows and sand grains hit my shell.

lines.zh: 沙滩的太阳晒得壳发烫。
lines.en: The beach sun has my shell hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 抬头看，天和海连成一条线。
lines.en: Looking up, sky and sea meet in one line.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，让太阳晒壳背。
lines.en: I turn so the sun hits the back of my shell.
The surf comes and goes like breathing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，跟礁石一样。
lines.en: I hold still as the rock.
A smell of salt and weed drifts over.

lines.zh: 我用钳子拨了拨面前的沙。
lines.en: I rake the sand in front of me with a claw.

lines.zh: 浪退的时候，我听见沙在响。
lines.en: As the wave pulls back, I hear the sand hiss.

lines.zh: 眼睛转了一圈，没什么新鲜事。
lines.en: I swivel my eyes. Nothing new.

lines.zh: 我在等退潮，那时最好找吃的。
lines.en: I'm waiting for low tide, the best time to feed.
So you've come to the shore too.

lines.zh: 我横着挪开一点，让你站。
lines.en: I sidestep a little to give you room.
You're standing in the surf; your boots will soak.
I look up, eye stalks fully out.
Don't crouch too close. I pinch.

lines.zh: 这滩上的蟹不止我一只。
lines.en: I'm not the only crab on this flat.
Here for shells?
Tide's coming. You'd best step back.

lines.zh: 我举了举钳子，算不上威胁。
lines.en: I lift a claw. It's hardly a threat.
Your prints in the sand go deep.
A white chip in my shell — that stings.
I slide a stretch sideways.
Wet sand's in the wound. It stings.
My claws have drooped.
I back toward the surf, slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我眼柄都歪了。
lines.en: That left my eye stalks askew.
I grip the rock and steady myself.
Stop. I don't take hits well.
The tide washes over the wound and it hurts more.
I squeeze into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 海水里有点腥味，是吃的。
lines.en: Something salty in the water. Food.
The wave pushed something in.
I work along the waterline that way.

lines.zh: 那味道，应该是死了的鱼。
lines.en: That smell is likely a dead fish.
That fish in your hand smells better than crab meat.
My claw is already out.
Push it a little closer and I can reach.

lines.zh: 潮水带来的东西最好吃。
lines.en: What the tide brings is the best eating.
I've waited half a day for this mouthful.
Right. I'm coming over.
You're standing on my leg.

lines.zh: 我被撞得在沙上滑了一段。
lines.en: The bump slid me along the sand.

lines.zh: 浪正好打来，我又滑回去。
lines.en: A wave chose that moment and slid me back.
The shell's hard. Bumping it doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 你别站这么近，潮会推我。
lines.en: Not so close; the tide pushes me.
I've put my claws away. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推进水里了。
lines.en: That pushed me into the water.
I grip the sand and slowly steady myself.

lines.zh: 你的脚印把浪引进来了。
lines.en: Your footprints let the water in.
Step back. I'm sunning here.

lines.zh: 我们在浪线边上碰钳子。
lines.en: We meet claw to claw at the surf line.
The surf drowns out everything else.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子又放下，这就是意思。
lines.en: I raise a claw and lower it. That's the meaning.
Under the sand is steadier than in the surf.

lines.zh: 你往这边靠，我往那边挪。
lines.en: You lean this way; I shift that way.

lines.zh: 我们都横着走，方向却一样。
lines.en: We both walk sideways, yet the same way.
Once the tide drops, it's quiet here.

lines.zh: 你的壳色浅，我一眼认出。
lines.en: Your shell's pale; I know you at a glance.
Don't pinch. My claws are softer than yours.

lines.zh: 就站在这儿，一块晒太阳。
lines.en: Let's just stand here and sun ourselves.

lines.zh: 浪把一条鱼推到我脚边。
lines.en: A wave pushed a fish to my feet.
I clamp it and drag it up the beach.
There's something alive in this shell.

lines.zh: 沙下埋着东西，我挖出来。
lines.en: Something's buried. I dig it out.
What the tide brings counts as mine.
I wedge it under a stone.
This one got stunned by the surf.
My grip's tight; the gulls can't take it.
When I've gathered enough, back to the burrow.
Plenty on the shore today.
Something moves at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我把钳子对准那个方向。
lines.en: I point both claws that way.
You've waded in; it's slippery there.

lines.zh: 我横着往旁边挪，找个角度。
lines.en: I sidestep for a better angle.

lines.zh: 这条潮线是我常走的路。
lines.en: This tide line is my usual route.

lines.zh: 沙滩上你的脚印，我一只只数。
lines.en: I count your footprints on the sand one by one.

lines.zh: 浪打来的声音会盖住脚步。
lines.en: The surf will cover footsteps.

lines.zh: 我看到你了，你站在礁石上。
lines.en: I see you, standing on the rock.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，两下之间有空档。
lines.en: I count the waves; there's a gap between two.

lines.zh: 沙里那点动静，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard that stir in the sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢横过来，一直对着你。
lines.en: I work my way over, always facing you.
Claws up, I haven't lowered them.

lines.zh: 潮水在你背后，你在往后退。
lines.en: The tide's behind you and you're backing up.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石走，湿地方便。
lines.en: I hug the rocks; wet ground suits me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进湿沙里了。
lines.en: Your boots are sinking in the wet sand.
I wait for you to come nearer.

lines.zh: 浪再来一次，就挡住你的视线。
lines.en: One more wave and your view's blocked.
From below the sand bank you can't climb.
I'm on your left, along the water.
All this stretch of sand is loose.
I pinch your trouser cuff.
My claw bites the boot and holds.
I charge sideways into your instep.
A light pinch. Only a reminder.
Pinch, then straight back into the surf.

lines.zh: 我拍了一钳子在你护腿上。
lines.en: I clap a claw on your leg guard.
I'm nimbler in the water.

lines.zh: 浪一推，我撞上你的膝盖。
lines.en: A wave shoves me into your knee.
Little strength, but the claws bite.
Come closer and I'll pinch your toes.
The wave pulls back and leaves me on the sand.
The beach sand is still wet.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我从湿沙里钻出。
lines.en: The tide is out; I crawl up through the wet sand.
The smell of the sea hits me.
I shake the water off.

lines.zh: 潮线往这边退了，我就跟过来。
lines.en: The tide line fell back here, so I followed.
Every crack on this beach is taken.
I crawl sideways onto dry ground.
The sun makes the sand shine.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等着潮水回来。
lines.en: I'll wait here for the tide to come back.
Fire makes my shell crackle.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上滑落，壳磕掉一块。
lines.en: I slip off the rock and knock a chip off my shell.

lines.zh: 浪把我卷进去，我分不清上下。
lines.en: The surf rolls me under; I lose up and down.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我抛到半空，又摔在沙上。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and slams me onto the sand.
An arrow grazes the rim of my shell.
Magic won't let my claws open.

lines.zh: 潮水一直不来，我只好干等。
lines.en: The tide won't come and I can only wait.

lines.zh: 雷打在海上，我壳上全是电。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and my shell carries the charge.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙也没有水，只是空。
lines.en: No sand, no water in the void. Only emptiness.
